title: German Potato Stew
description: A hearty German-inspired potato stew made with tender chunks of potato and flavorful stew meat.

ingredients.name: juicy stew meat
ingredients.notes: beef or pork, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, if using, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, flour, beef broth, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley, if desired.
